content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where Stripe and PayPal are severely restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in receiving [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-how-one-creator-2|payment]]s for their products. This infrastructure problem necessitates a sovereign commerce solution, enabling creators to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-12|How to]], courses, and software without relying on conventional platforms. This post breaks down how Google Apps Script can be used for digital commerce automation, eliminating the need for Stripe and similar services.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based platform that allows users to create and automate tasks within the Google ecosystem. For digital commerce, it can be used to automate order fulfillment, sending download links to customers after a payment is confirmed. This is particularly useful for creators who sell digital products and need a reliable way to deliver them to their customers without manual intervention. By automating this process, creators can save time and reduce the likelihood of errors, ensuring a better customer experience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack using Google Apps Script involves integrating it with a payment gateway like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. When a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments sends a webhook notification to the Google Apps Script, which then triggers the automation script to send the download link to the customer. This process can be [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-google-apps-script-digital-commerce|COREMERCH guide to complete]]d in under 30 seconds, ensuring timely delivery of digital products. The use of Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script as the backend logic, combined with Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, provides a scalable and reliable infrastructure for digital commerce automation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or restricted. By using a sovereign commerce stack, creators can maintain full ownership and control over their sales process, without relying on third-party platforms that may impose restrictions or fees. This is particularly important for creators who sell digital products, as it allows them to reach a global audience without being limited by geographical restrictions. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an example of a pre-configured solution that includes everything needed to get started with digital commerce automation, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments.
Cloudflare Workers can handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a payment gateway like NOWPayments. These components work together to provide a seamless and automated sales process, from payment confirmation to product delivery. By using these components, creators can build a scalable and reliable infrastructure for their digital commerce needs, without relying on conventional platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. They can choose a hosting platform, a backend logic platform, an order storage solution, and a payment gateway, and then integrate these components using APIs and webhooks. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a pre-configured solution that includes everything needed to get started, and can be deployed in 48 hours. By following this approach, creators can quickly and easily set up a scalable and reliable infrastructure for their digital commerce needs, and start selling their products to a global audience.

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by using a webhook to trigger the delivery process after a payment is confirmed. This can be achieved using a platform like Google Apps Script, which can be integrated with a payment gateway like NOWPayments to automate the delivery of digital products. By using this approach, creators can ensure timely and reliable delivery of their products, without manual intervention. The use of Cloudflare Workers, which can handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, provides a scalable and reliable infrastructure for automated digital product delivery.

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, choose a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, select an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, integrate a payment gateway like NOWPayments, and configure the webhook to trigger the delivery process after a payment is confirmed. Next, test the automation script to ensure it is working correctly, and then deploy the stack to start selling digital products. Finally, monitor the performance of the stack and make adjustments as needed to ensure reliable and timely delivery of digital products.
